change: jsonld-software.html is now opt-in via site.jsonld_software_application
method: Two real Jekyll builds of this repo, identical except for the new config flag. The opt-out column is byte-for-byte what EVERY consumer homepage emitted before this change, because the include was previously ungated.
page_measured: index.html (homepage — the only page the include ever targeted)

before_ungated_every_consumer.note: Identical to the opt-in column: before this change there was no flag, so every site got this.

after_optin_themes_own_site.note: _config.yml sets jsonld_software_application: true — behaviour preserved exactly.

after_optout_consumer_default.note: Flag absent/false — the default for every consumer. Standard SEO metadata is untouched; only the theme-describing graph is gone.
